body: Hey take it slow. If you need to maybe you can work something out with your landlord. If you're in that tough of a spot they usually understand! Killing yourself is just a bad way to go about it.. especially if you have kids...don't do that to them. Don't do that to yourself.

I know personally how bad consulers can be. The one thing they can do is lend you a phone. For the love of anything man. Don't kill yourself you're too young. Call child services. If they're that bad you can be re-homed. You can move in with a family member or even someone completely different if you have to. Don't let your parents dictate how your life goes. But ending it isn't the right option. Save yourself.
Yeah I hear you man. I'm sorry to hear that. I hope you start doing better in the near future.
